entries.20c046eb246ae037: This business provides advice when companies carry out acquisitions or mergers, acting as an intermediary between sellers and buyers, or as financial advisor to one side. Its main business domain is the market in which domestic small and medium-sized enterprises are the parties, and it supports M&A as project management work that manages and executes the series of M&A processes. Revenue for the fiscal year ended November 2025 was ¥864 million, accounting for all consolidated revenue.
